event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis led, energy rebounded, breadth didn't confirm.
SOXX +1.35% to a +14.93% 20d while SPY added just 0.18% — a narrow, top-heavy tape. Today's ISM Manufacturing PMI printed 54.5 vs 55 forecast, and core PCE (released 9/30) came in at 3.0% y/y vs 3.3% forecast — soft inflation, firm growth, no Fed scare into tomorrow's NFP (fc +9k payrolls, fc 4.1% unemployment).

INDICES — VIX 16.4, above its 15.9 20-day MA but mid-range.
Ranked: SOXX +1.35%, IJH +1.04%, SLV +0.94%, IJR +0.68%, GLD +0.50%, RSP +0.47%, IWM +0.41%, QQQ +0.31%, SPY +0.18%, DIA +0.01%. Small > large by 0.37pp. Notable cross-asset: USO +2.99%. No index below its 200-DMA.

VOLUME & BREADTH — RSP traded 2.2x average, IJH 1.9x, IJR 1.6x: equal-weight and mid-cap accumulation. SPY vol_ratio unavailable; QQQ unavailable in the block. Losers on light volume: SOXX 0.9x, GLD 0.6x — the semis rally is thin. XLU 2.4x and XLB 2.3x gained on heavy volume. Breadth diverges: only 23% of the S&P 500 sits above its 50-DMA, 41% above the 200-DMA, with 74 new 60-day lows vs 14 highs.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.95%, XLK Technology +1.05%, XLI Industrials +0.99%, XLU Utilities +0.61%, XLF Financials +0.11%, XLY Discretionary -0.03%, XLP Staples -0.33%, XLB Materials -0.33%, XLRE Real Estate -0.56%, XLC Comms -0.93%, XLV Healthcare -1.32%.
Top industries: USO +2.99%, XOP +2.77%; bottom: IBB -2.17%, TAN -2.05%.
Flows contradict price: XLY pulled +$711mm (100th pctile) while XLV bled -$1,089mm (2nd pctile) and XLE -$890mm (2nd pctile) despite leading. Money is in energy and semis, out of financials (-$2,305mm) and healthcare. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.05 signals protection demand; QQQ 0.75 is lighter. SPY GEX flip 665 vs spot 762.70 — far above, no amplification risk. VIX above its 20-day MA, and VIXEQ 39.2 vs VIX 16.4 is a wide dispersion gap — a rotation, stock-picker tape, not correlated macro.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +2.99% (USO) lifted energy while the dollar gained 0.66% (UUP), a mild headwind for gold's +0.50%. HYG -0.40% and LQD -0.15% show credit lagging equities. Next FOMC Oct 28; CME FedWatch prices 100% hike — but Polymarket shows 74% no-change vs 26% hike, a 40pp five-day swing toward hold.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50, Neutral. Movers: DHR -4.42% (CEO succession risk), GEV +3.89%, TER +3.71% (Magnum E2 launch), IJK +1.13% on 5.4x volume, IJJ +0.98% at 3.7x. Watch USO (+2.99%, energy leadership), GLD (+0.50% but 0.6x volume, dollar-pressured), and XLE (+1.95% yet 2nd-pctile outflows — flow/price divergence).
